# I-AM Personal Context

> A compact, portable I-AM string format for injecting personal context (communication style, personality, preferences) into AI systems.

Raw Markdown documentation (fetch directly, no HTML rendering):

- [README](https://iampersonalcontext.org/README.md): project overview, I-AM string format, quick start, architecture
- [I-AM String Format Overview](https://iampersonalcontext.org/docs/iam.md): specification of the I-AM string segments and traits
- [I-AM Use Cases](https://iampersonalcontext.org/docs/iam-usecase.md): applied use cases for the I-AM string
- [Developer: Long Form Integration](https://iampersonalcontext.org/docs/developer/iam-lf.md): notes on the long-form I-AM output
- [Developer: UI Guide](https://iampersonalcontext.org/docs/developer/ui.md): running and building the UI
